titulo.alumno: A short review · Culture and leisure

intro: Part 2: a short review. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: In a simple review, separate the information (what, where and when) from the opinion. Adjectives such as «spændende» and «kedelig» express an opinion; the comparative lets you contrast two proposals.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
